propositions: rebar transition command reports lock error to stderr with exit code 0 approximately 60s after the close has durably committed, silently downgrading the ticket to closed-WITHOUT-signature

close_ticket releases the STATUS event lock before the signing tail runs, causing a transient write_lock timeout during sign_completion_verdict to fail the signature append without being machine-readable to callers

the return payload from close_ticket carries no field indicating success or failure of the completion signature, making the loss undetectable programmatically across all three public surfaces (library, CLI, MCP)

callers cannot distinguish between a transient lock timeout (which succeeds at close but loses signature) and a permanent signing infrastructure failure, or between an intentional force-close bypass and an unexpected failure
